says: Which component stands at which address of the card. It names no place and no device: only a component's name in map.live and an address in map.card. An address may hold several components; a component stands at one address. What the card has and the build does not is under missing; where the two disagree is under conflicts.

missing.health: Nothing gathers health. The pi0 writes itself down every minute and the pi5 has its shape check, but each keeps it to itself.
missing.alerts: Nothing raises an alert. The pi0's wallpaper stops being green only on the pi0.
missing.brain to site: A brain reaches the store through door and the site through a browser, never one through the other: the site fetches nothing.
missing.Muse on the tailnet: Muse's seat runs on the mac and is not yet a tailnet member.

conflicts.two doors: The board's Shape door and the door Worker are both an entry, under one word. The triangle holds door; the board's door is under Ask.
conflicts.two stores of thought: daq.store (git, on the stick) and D1 (door's records) both keep thought.
conflicts.places: A sheet may not name a place, and the card is places. So map.card is a skin, outside the sheet grammar: the browser's answer only.
conflicts.portrait on landscape: The card is portrait and the surface landscape. The card stands in the middle; the diagram uses the margins.
conflicts.live is a snapshot: The site fetches nothing, so the diagram is what map.live saw on its day, until it is written again.
